# Poly Haven textures (CC0)

Source: https://polyhaven.com — released under CC0 (public domain); no
attribution required. Full-resolution sources kept here unmodified; the game
uses 1K mobile derivatives in assets/textures/pbr/ built by
tools/blender/build_pbr_textures.py.

- brick_wall_006 (2K): diffuse, OpenGL normal, ARM (AO/roughness/metal), AO, roughness
- asphalt_02 (2K): same set
